name: Normally-closed limit switch
summary: A normally-closed limit switch opens when the documented mechanical position actuates it.
description: A normally-closed limit switch opens when the documented mechanical position actuates it. The reference position must be stated so the logic is interpretable during rest and travel.
readingNotes: Trace the circuit in both actuated and unactuated states.
